body:
Superseded by #5929 (same request: UniPathway UPA00196 maps the GPI transamidase subunits gaa1/gab1/gpi17/gpi16 to GO:0006506 GPI anchor biosynthetic process instead of GO:0016255 attachment of GPI anchor to protein; #5929 lists the annotation lines for all four).
